data.text: Frozen corpus: pin 01M3XZ6NSCHCD22JHHR40GZ1ZZ, the last event on main, 1124 events; a test fails if the count under the pin changes (re-pin on purpose). Golden on it: 19/25 before KAD-69, floor 0.68. Caveat it reported: CLAUDE.md loaded into its context named cac, blessed, BM25, Probe A, prime, so a few phrasings carry project terms. Baseline before any ranking change: top-1 27, top-3 33, top-5 35, silent 3. The plan's 75 blind dev questions lived in a past session's scratchpad and are gone, so the dev set is the 25 golden only.
